recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast close-up of a man's face, partially obscured by his own hand and forearm. The subject features long dark hair and an intense, direct gaze from one visible eye. The forearm is covered in a colorful, illustrative tattoo sleeve. The composition is anchored by a mix of traditional blackletter-inspired display type and clean sans-serif secondary text positioned in the upper quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The hand creates a diagonal frame that isolates the subject's eye.
The warm skin tones contrast with the cool blue and black of the primary typography.
The intricate detail of the tattoo balances the smooth, out-of-focus background.
coreInvariants: Partial facial occlusion by a hand
Direct eye contact with the viewer
Warm, directional lighting with soft shadows
Film-like grain texture across the entire image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally, with the face filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The visible eye, positioned near the vertical center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold blue typography, follows the diagonal line of the arm down to the eye, then rests on the mouth and tattoo details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the upper corners and the dark hair framing the face.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones and deep browns (skin and hair).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the lit side of the face and the dark hair; saturation is concentrated in the tattoo and text.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly synthetic colors
Maintain a naturalistic, slightly desaturated skin palette

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stress with sharp, angular terminals
Elongated descender on the initial character
Lowercase letters maintain a consistent x-height with heavy strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'j' features a long, curved tail that acts as a visual divider
The 'u' and 'a' have simplified, modern gothic connections

composition.position: Top left quadrant, overlapping the hand
To the right of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between a decorative, historical display face and a functional, modern sans-serif.

preserve: The blue color of the main text
avoid: Standard serif fonts like Times New Roman

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, angular blackletter aesthetic of the display text.
Provides the clean, humanist sans-serif contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, high-contrast close-up photo of a man with long dark hair, his hand covering the top half of his face so only one eye is visible. The arm features a colorful, traditional-style tattoo. Warm, directional lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold blue blackletter word in the top left, overlapping the hand. To its right, add a small, bold white sans-serif phrase in lowercase.

verificationChecks: Is the eye the focal point?
Does the blue text have a long descender on the first letter?
Is the film grain visible across the image?
Is the tattoo colorful and illustrative?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hand placement feels natural and not forced.
Check that the blue text is legible against the skin tone.
Verify the grain doesn't obscure the subject's eye detail.
Confirm the sans-serif text is perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Close-up portrait + diagonal limb occlusion + blackletter/sans-serif typographic pairing + warm filmic grading.
